diagnosis: All four rollouts passed check C1, despite A2's PF1 fact being unavailable in all of them. This suggests that the model is defaulting to a streaming architecture due to the absence of any evidence against it, as streaming is the only viable option when PF1 is not available. Check C1 should be tightened to ensure it depends on the correct fact.
